description: This Java source file defines the class 'DeviceCertificateValidator', which implements certificate chain validation for devices using the PKIX algorithm. It validates X.509 certificate chains against trust anchors, primarily for security purposes within an Eclipse Hono service.

classes.name: DeviceCertificateValidator
classes.description: Implements the validation of device X.509 certificate chains using Java's PKIX validation framework. Provides methods to validate certificate chains with trust anchors.

methods.name: validate(List<X509Certificate>, TrustAnchor)
methods.description: Validates a certificate chain against a single trust anchor.

methods.name: validate(List<X509Certificate>, Set<TrustAnchor>)
methods.description: Validates a certificate chain against a set of trust anchors, performing PKIX validation and handling exceptions accordingly.
